subject: Post-sign MAP & onboarding orchestration for HealthVista
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>;
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>, Elena Torres <elena.torres@healthvista.com>, Mark Baker <mark.baker@healthvista.com>
Date: Tue, 4 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-sign MAP & onboarding orchestration for HealthVista

Hi team —

Thanks again for the quick close last week. Per our plan, I’m kicking off the MAP so CS can pick up ownership of activation and the evaluation cadence. Quick summary (details + timeline in the attached MAP):

- Go-live target: 2027-06-01 (pilot scope: claims triage + clinical note summarization)
- Evaluation window: 4 weeks of pilot, weekly quality check-ins, final eval on 2027-06-28
- Red flags: PII ingestion, latency SLAs for the triage route, and model hallucination thresholds

Action items I’m proposing now:
1) Marissa — CS lead for activation and weekly check-ins (primary contact for HealthVista)
2) Rishi — Tech enablement & escalation for model tuning + infra requirements
3) Sean — Solutions contact for integrations and data mapping
4) HealthVista — provide a technical lead and compliance contact so we can scope SOC2/data flow details

Attachments: HealthVista_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP with milestones & owners), HV_SOW_signed.pdf
Links: shared MAP doc: https://docs.redwood.com/shared/HealthVista/MAP-v1

Requested next steps:
- Marissa: can you confirm you’ll own the 0–30 day plan and propose kickoff slots (I suggested Thu 5/7 or Mon 5/10 below)?
- HealthVista: please confirm attendees for the kickoff and share your tech/compliance leads.

I’ll send a calendar invite after we confirm the time. Thanks everyone — excited to get this moving.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

--
Attachment: HealthVista_MAP_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet, 24kb)
Attachment: HV_SOW_signed.pdf (pdf, 180kb)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>, Elena Torres <elena.torres@healthvista.com>, Mark Baker <mark.baker@healthvista.com>
Date: Tue, 4 May 2027 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-sign MAP & onboarding orchestration for HealthVista

Thanks Grace — happy to own this. A few clarifying notes from the CS side:

- I’ll own the 0–30 day activation plan and the weekly check-ins you outlined. I’ll publish the 30/60/90 playbook in our CS tracker once we confirm the kickoff scope.
- Can Rishi confirm whether we need a test data export or if HealthVista will provide a synthetic subset for initial validation? That will affect our integration prep timeline.
- HealthVista: please confirm a technical lead + security/compliance contact so I can add them to our onboarding tracker. Also, are there calendar constraints for week-of-5/7? I can do Thu 5/7 at 10:00 PT or Mon 5/10 at 11:00 PT — both work on my end.

I’ll prepare a short agenda for the kickoff (30–45 min): introductions, MAP milestones, integration checklist, evaluation criteria, next steps.

Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
--

Hi Grace / Marissa —

Thanks for the clear plan. We’re aligned to proceed. Confirming attendees from HealthVista for the kickoff:

- Elena Torres — Sponsor / Care Ops lead
- Mark Baker — Product Owner (integration scope)
- Aaron Li — Technical lead (will own schema + test data)
- Judy Nguyen — Compliance (SOC2 / data handling questions)

We prefer Thu 5/7 at 10:00 AM PT for the kickoff. Week 0 cadence: weekly check-ins for the first 4 weeks sounds right. We will provide a synthetic subset of data for initial validation — Aaron will share that by 5/6.

Elena
Elena Torres
VP, Care Operations

Perfect — thanks Elena and team. I’ve booked the kickoff for Thu, 7 May 2027 at 10:00 AM PT and sent a calendar invite (https://cal.meet/rdw-grace/healthvista-kickoff-20270507).

Marissa — I added you as the primary owner in the MAP tracker and flagged these immediate asks:
- Rishi: confirm infra checklist and whether a sample export is required (Rishi, suggested by EOD 5/6)
- Aaron: share synthetic dataset by EOD 5/6
- Judy: any particular compliance artifacts we should prepare before kickoff (SOC2 scope, data retention spec)

I’ll include the MAP doc and SOW in the invite. Marissa, let me know if you want me to run introductions or if you prefer to lead the kickoff.

Thanks all — see you Thursday.

Grace
